title: It was cracked, but maybe salvageable.
text:
It was cracked, but maybe salvageable.. I think it is beautiful!!!
But, when I opened it, it was cleanly cracked in half. (The marble broke away from the wood.)
I could see they really tried to package it well.
They do have a small disk that slides to connect the two pieces together.
I’m trying to decide if I’m going to return it, or just keep it and slip some glue to hold it together.
It’s really just a Very pretty ornament for collectors!

product_metadata.title: Thirstystone Large Texas Shaped Mango Wood & Marble Serving/Cutting Board, Made From All Natural Materials, Kitchen Accessories & Decor 16" x 15"
features: CONSTRUCTED- This attractive Serving Tray is constructed of natural white Marble and accented with Mango wood. Marble & Mango Wood are both known to be highly water repellant. Marble will also hold coldness for long periods of time.
DURABLE- Marble and wood are both known for their durability, making them an ideal material for a serving tray that can withstand the wear and tear of everyday use.
DESIGN: Board is shaped in the state of Texas. Show your Texas pride with this cutting board it is not quite as big as the State, but it's plenty big enough to handle whatever you may need it for.

VERSATILE: This natural marble and wood serving tray can be used for serving a variety of food and drink items, such as cheeses, appetizers, cocktails, and desserts. Use this tray for food preparation, you can slice and chop your food easily. Use as a charcuterie tray or cheese tray.
HEAT TOLERANT: Marble and wood are both heat tolerant, making them suitable for serving hot items such as baked goods, hot drinks, or even freshly cooked food.

MEASURES- This Serving Tray measures 16” x 15.25” x 1”. Natural marble and wood serving trays are easy to clean with just a damp cloth and mild soap. They should not be soaked in water or placed in a dishwasher.
